jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market/Enterprise
jobs.description:
The role of a Mid-Market/Enterprise CSM is to work with a portfolio of customers to drive adoption, increase satisfaction, add revenue, mitigate risk, and identify customer needs in order to increase loyalty and retain business on a one-to-many scale. This position will also include coaching, mentoring and supporting the team in teaching best practices.

 - This position will be hybrid (remote/in office)

 - Reports to: Director of Enterprise Customer Success


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Managing a book of Priority Accounts

 - Able to collaboratively address and tailor solutions to the customer’s needs.

 - Establish oneself as a trusted advisor integral to the customer’s success.

 - Welcome both new and existing customers to Customer Success and set proper expectations for success

 - Conducts a comprehensive review of industry trends and the customers latest developments.

 - Offering insights and guidance tailored specifically to the customers competitive environment

 - Set up and perform regular Introduction calls, Account Reviews, and Business Reviews, making recommendations to Weave’s products & services

 - Collaboratively work across departments to find solutions for customers

 - Provides unique, actionable insights that the customer hasn’t considered before becoming more of an “advisor” than “vendor”

 - Ability to understand not just the product, but market landscape, competition and how the product fits into broader industry trends.

 - Work in conjunction with the upsell team to drive more revenue per customer

 - Ability to use metrics and data to support their positions and quantify value, thereby making negotiations more objective

 - Ability to create complex reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights, beyond just tracking KPI’s.

 - Impact retention by helping customers see the value in what they are paying for, and help turn them into champions

 - Maintain consistent updates in Salesforce and Zendesk to provide an accurate overview of customers' current state.

 - Has a deep understanding of industry trends, challenges, and opportunities, often providing value by informing customers of ways to innovate and stay ahead of the curve.

 - Work with our support team to identify deficiencies in the process and current customer support needs

 - Constantly looking for new ways to improve customer success processes, customer experience, and internal operations.

 - Participate in special projects as needed and directed by your team lead


WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

The minimum qualifications for the role - education, experience, certifications, skills.

 - 3+ years of CSM or Account Management experience supporting Mid-Market and/or Enterprise customers

 - Demonstrate Weave's core values

 - Contribute to a positive work environment and team culture

 - Ability to demonstrate ethical behavior and decision making at all times

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor

 - Ability to build relationships with a wide variety of both customers and internal stakeholders

 - Ability to function as a consultant for the customer and balance that with the needs of the business

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to handle multiple projects at once and prioritize each respectively

 - Proactive problem solving skills




WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

Preferred qualifications - including personality traits and soft skills.

 - A positive attitude with a willingness to contribute where needed

 - Bachelor’s degree preferred

 - Extensive experience in customer-facing roles

 - Previous Customer Success experience

 - Experience in Salesforce, Zendesk and Google Suite and Planhat (not necessary, but nice to have)

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, SMB
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a motivated and people-focused Customer Success Manager to support a portfolio of single-location and small multi-location SMB accounts. In this role, you’ll help customers get real results from our software, build lasting partnerships, and play a key role in keeping and growing those relationships over time.

 - This is a hybrid position, working Monday-Wednesday in office, Thursday/Friday are optional work from home days. 

 - Reports to: Manager of Customer Success


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Customer Success: Be a dedicated partner for your accounts, helping them solve challenges, reach goals, and get maximum value from our software.

 - Retention: Take the lead on keeping customers engaged and successful, working proactively to reduce churn and strengthen loyalty.

 - Upsells & Growth: Spot and nurture growth opportunities by building on trusted relationships, sparking interest in new offerings, and connecting customers with solutions that add real value.

 - Strategic Guidance: Become a trusted partner to your customers, helping them link their business goals to practical outcomes with our software.

 - Ongoing Training: Provide ongoing education when new features launch, making sure customers are confident and getting the most value from our tools.

 - Engagement: Conduct regular business reviews that spotlight customer wins, reinforce outcomes, and create space to explore what’s next.

 - Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Onboarding teams to share feedback, solve challenges, and represent the customer’s voice.

 - Problem Resolution: Handle escalations quickly and thoughtfully, maintaining customer trust and strengthening the relationship.

 - Advocacy: Partner with happy customers to capture success stories, gather testimonials, and encourage positive reviews that highlight the value of our solutions.


WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

 - 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or another client-facing role (SaaS or tech experience a plus)

 - Proven ability to keep customers engaged, happy, and achieving their goals.

 - Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work with both small business owners and internal teams.

 - Comfortable hosting on-camera meetings and delivering a professional, engaging presence with customers.

 - Skilled at reading account data and translating it into steps that improve retention and drive success.

 - Highly organized and able to manage multiple accounts while keeping attention to detail.

 - Experience using Salesforce, Vitally, or Zoom to manage accounts and connect with customers is a plus.


WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

 - Background supporting customers in healthcare-related industries (dental, optometry, veterinary, or medical) that will help you connect with many of our customers.

 - A customer-first mindset and genuine passion for helping small businesses succeed.

 - Comfort uncovering customer needs and teaming up with Sales to match them with the right solutions.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
As the Senior HR Business Partner for India, you will provide high-impact HR partnership to India and US-based leaders and employees, aligning business priorities with Weave’s global People strategy and the needs of our India workforce. You will serve as a key stakeholder across the employee lifecycle, partnering closely with People Team functional and program owners in areas including onboarding, compliance, performance management, employee relations, engagement, hiring, events, and culture. Rather than operating as a standalone HR function, you will connect leaders, employees, and People Team partners to drive effective execution and strong outcomes in India. You will also serve as a strategic advisor and coach to leaders, bringing local insight and perspective to help strengthen our culture and employee experience in India.

 - This position reports to Director HRBPs & Employee Experience.

 - This position is remote (India)
   


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Strategic Advising & Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted HR advisor to leaders with India based employees and own how Weave's global people strategy comes to life in India. Shape initiatives while they are still being designed, not after they land.

 - Talent Insights & Analytics: Own the story behind India's talent data. Translate trends in attrition, hiring, performance, and engagement into recommendations leaders act on.

 - Global & Cultural Partnership: Be Weave's expert voice on the India employee experience and employment landscape, and make that experience something the whole People Team carries, not just one person.

 - Performance & Compensation: Support the compensation cycles in India, from calibration to manager coaching, partnering with Total Rewards on the global framework and bringing India market realities into the conversation.

 - Employee Relations: Own employee relations in India in a proactive manner, coaching managers through difficult moments and resolving concerns with fairness and sound judgment, in close partnership with the Director of HRBPs and Legal on sensitive matters.

 - Compliance & POSH: Own the India compliance landscape and serve as our first line for spotting risk, working alongside Legal, and external partners who handle statutory execution.

 - Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Own workforce planning input and hiring manager readiness, and shape a new-hire experience people remember, partnering closely with our India recruiters and the Global Talent Acquisition team.

 - Engagement & Culture: Own the India engagement action plan and hold leaders accountable to it, partnering with Employee Experience so India's story connects to Weave's broader culture.

 - India Programs & Events: Own India Meets, town halls, recognition, and celebrations from concept through execution. These are yours to build.
   


WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred.

 - 7 plus years experience as a HRBP.

 - Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
   


WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

 - Experience building relationships and trust with stakeholders.

 - Experience working in a fast paced environment & willingness to take ownership for work outcomes.

 - Previous experience working in a technology company.

 - Experience working in a fast growth organization where scaling HR was needed.

 - Previously supporting an organization of 200+ employees.

 - Previous experience working with a U.S. based company.

 - Willingness to embrace the AI change and use these tools to further your work.

 - Ability to manage and lead cross-functional projects.

 - Working Some US hours will be required every week.
